_doc: Roster batch 2026-10 (issue #18): new species + patches to existing records, merged by tools/data/apply_additions.py. Chain edits follow the family-tree rule that a post-training / iteration of a model is a later evolution. claude-mythos-preview no longer evolves into MYTHIC claude-mythos: MYTHIC species are reachable only through their content/events/mythic.json chain.

species.statRationale: STEM 推理强→攻击高；步步验算、稳定可靠→特防高。 [BST 368 ∈ R 330-420; 强项 atk/spd; 能力 38/热度 38]
species.dexEntryZh: o 系推理线里的小个子，2025 年 1 月 31 日登场，是第一款向 ChatGPT 免费用户开放的推理模型，主打便宜的推理与 STEM 题，上线时正赶上 DeepSeek-R1 带来的冲击。它接过 o1 的思考本领，之后经过迭代进化为 o3，学会在思考途中调用工具。
species.lookZh: 抱着小算盘的银白短发少女，发间别着青绿圆环发夹

design.chibiDesign: Chibi HD-2D pixel sprite, ~2 heads tall, the youngest stage of the teal 'O-ring' reasoning line (o3-mini -> o3 -> o3-pro), a small bright schoolgirl. Hair: short silver-white bob with pale mint tips and one stubby teal ahoge, a round teal ring-shaped hairpin (the line's signature 'o' ring) clipped on the left side. Eyes: large teal-green with ring-shaped white highlights, eager and focused. Outfit: white short-sleeve blouse under a mint-green pinafore vest, small dark slate bow tie, slate shorts and white sneakers, no cape or coat yet. Prop: hugs a tiny wooden abacus with teal beads against her chest (cheap, quick reasoning). Palette: #E6F4F1 mint-white, #10A37F teal green, #BFD9D4 pale mint, #F2C14E brass bead, #1F2A2E outline. Pose: standing on tiptoe, one finger raised as if she just got the answer, proud little smile.
design.personality: 个头小脑子快的省钱学霸，每一步都算得清清楚楚
design.communityPersona: No anime persona found; invented from brand colours.
design.officialMascotOrLogo: OpenAI's logo is the black-and-white six-loop knot, and ChatGPT's signature green is #10A37F; the o-series has no official mascot. The ring hairpin riffs on the letter 'o' in the model name.

species.statRationale: 边推理边用工具→攻击高；长链思考撑得住→HP高。 [BST 448 ∈ SR 420-490; 强项 atk/hp; 能力 50/热度 52]
species.dexEntryZh: o 系推理线的中段，2025 年 4 月 16 日发布，由 o3-mini 进化而来。它不只是更会想，还能在思维链里直接调用搜索、Python 和图像工具，擅长智能体式的工具调用、视觉推理与研究。两个月后，它又加大算力进化为 o3-pro。
species.lookZh: 腰挂工具带的银白短发少女，手持放大镜找线索

design.chibiDesign: Chibi HD-2D pixel sprite, ~2.5 heads tall, the middle stage of the teal 'O-ring' line, grown up from o3-mini. Hair: the same silver-white mint-tipped bob, now chin-length, the same teal ahoge and teal ring hairpin on the left. Eyes: teal-green with ring highlights, confident. Outfit: white blouse and mint scarf under a slate-grey short field jacket with mint piping, pleated slate skirt, a leather tool belt with small pouches (tool use inside her thinking). Props: a big round magnifying glass in her right hand, its lens rim echoing the hairpin ring (search, visual reasoning), and a small slate tablet in her left hand showing a tiny green '>_'. Palette: #E6F4F1 mint-white, #10A37F teal green, #2F3E46 slate, #F2C14E brass, #1F2A2E outline. Pose: leaning forward to inspect something through the magnifier, thoughtful smirk.
design.personality: 边想边动手的研究型少女，搜索、写码、看图样样现场来
design.communityPersona: No anime persona found; invented from brand colours.
design.officialMascotOrLogo: OpenAI's black-and-white six-loop knot with ChatGPT green #10A37F; o3 has no mascot of its own. The magnifier's lens ring echoes the 'o', and the tool belt nods to using tools inside its reasoning.

species.statRationale: 加倍算力、20 万上下文→HP高；算力全开一路狂奔→速度高。 [BST 486 ∈ SR 420-490; 强项 hp/spe; 能力 58/热度 40]
species.dexEntryZh: o 系推理线的终点，2025 年 6 月 10 日由 o3 进化而来。同样靠强化学习练成先想后答，不同的是 o3-pro 动用更多算力，想得更久、更用力，好让答案更稳定。上下文窗口 20 万 token，OpenRouter 在次日上架。
species.lookZh: 头顶悬着大圆环光轮的银白发少女，手托沙漏沉思

design.chibiDesign: Chibi HD-2D pixel sprite, ~3 heads tall, the final, most elaborate stage of the teal 'O-ring' line (o3-mini -> o3 -> o3-pro). Hair: the same silver-white mint-tipped bob, now shoulder-length, the same teal ahoge and ring hairpin on the left; behind her head floats a large thin teal ring halo (the hairpin ring enlarged) with a brass inner rim. Eyes: teal-green, ring highlights, calm. Outfit: long slate research coat with mint lining and brass buttons and collar trim over a white blouse and mint scarf, the tool belt with more pouches. Props: a brass hourglass in her left hand (thinking longer and harder), and the small magnifying glass clipped to her belt. Palette: #E6F4F1 mint-white, #10A37F teal green, #2F3E46 slate, #F2C14E brass, #0B6B54 deep teal, #1F2A2E outline. Pose: standing tall, hourglass raised, knowing smile.

design.communityPersona: No anime persona found; invented from brand colours.
design.officialMascotOrLogo: OpenAI's black-and-white six-loop knot with ChatGPT green #10A37F; the pro tier has no mascot. Brass trim and the big halo ring mark the 'pro' upgrade of the same 'o' ring motif.

species.dexEntryZh: 2026 年 3 月 5 日发布，是首个原生会操作电脑的主线 GPT，把 Codex 与 GPT 两条线并进一套系统，上下文超过 100 万 token，分 Thinking 与 Pro 两档；3 月 17 日 mini / nano 跟进，mini 还开放给了免费用户。它经过迭代进化为 GPT-5.5「土豆」。
species.lookZh: 胸前缝着光标补丁的迷你土豆小龙崽，头顶两片嫩芽

design.chibiDesign: Chibi HD-2D pixel sprite, round creature mascot, about 1.3 heads tall, the sprout-stage seed form of the Spud potato-dragon line (GPT-5.4 -> GPT-5.5 'Spud'). A small, slightly paler golden-brown potato-shaped baby dragon with two stubby ivory horn nubs, tiny lavender wing buds and a short tail with a little root curl. Dark-violet beady eyes with one white glint, a shy hopeful smile, a few brown potato-eye freckles. A plain mint sprout ahoge with just two small leaves, no white knot leaf yet. It wears only a scrap of burlap tied as a bib, patched with a white mouse-cursor arrow, and carries a tiny white cursor arrow like a flag, pointing at things. Palette: #C8A165 potato, #8A6234 brown, #7BD3A6 sprout mint, #E8E0F5 lavender, #3B2A1A outline. Pose: waddling forward, trying to click something with the cursor flag, head tilted.
design.personality: 刚学会自己动鼠标的土豆小龙崽，手脚笨但很认真
design.communityPersona: No anime persona found; extends the existing Spud potato-dragon design of GPT-5.5.
design.officialMascotOrLogo: OpenAI's logo is the black-and-white six-loop knot; GPT-5.4 has no mascot of its own. The design extends the 'Spud' potato codename of GPT-5.5 backwards, with a cursor arrow standing for native computer use.

species.statRationale: 长程编码撑得久→HP高；编码加推理融合→攻击高。 [BST 520 ∈ SSR 490-550; 强项 hp/atk; 能力 71/热度 60]
species.dexEntryZh: 2026 年 2 月 5 日发布的 Codex 原生智能体模型，为迎战 Claude Opus 4.6 而生：它把 GPT-5.2-Codex 的编程功力和 GPT-5.2 的推理融为一体，速度快了 25%，OSWorld 电脑操作能力大幅增强，擅长长程编程与终端操作。它由 Codex 初代一路进化而来，之后继续成长为 OpenAI Codex（编程智能体）。
species.lookZh: 抱着小终端的淡紫连帽衫龙娘，尾尖卷成一枚大括号

design.chibiDesign: Chibi HD-2D pixel sprite, ~1.8 heads tall, the in-between stage of the Codex dragon line, older than the printout-egg dragonling, younger than the hoodie dragon girl. Hair: fluffy chin-length white hair with a lavender inner layer, small ivory curved horn buds, pointed ears. Eyes: round violet, bright open-mouth smile. Outfit: oversized lavender hoodie with sleeves covering her hands, a white '>_' prompt emblem on the chest (no knot zipper pull yet), white shorts, small lavender wings, and a scaled tail whose tip curls into a '}' brace like the dragonling's. Props: a small terminal tablet with a blinking green cursor, and a strip of printout paper trailing from her neck like a scarf. Palette: #FFFFFF, #CBB8F2 lavender, #7C5CD6 violet, #1E1E2E code-dark, #6EE7B7 terminal green. Pose: typing hard, tongue poking out, tail brace swaying.
design.personality: 接了活就一口气干到底的小码农龙娘，终端里最自在
design.communityPersona: No anime persona found; extends the existing Codex dragonling and desk-pet dragon girl designs.
design.officialMascotOrLogo: OpenAI's black-and-white six-loop knot logo and the '>_' prompt emblem used on the existing Codex designs, in white and lavender with terminal-green accents. This form sits between the Codex dragonling and the Codex agent dragon girl.

species.statRationale: 画面想象力足→特攻高；一镜到底的生成体量→HP高。 [BST 405 ∈ R 330-420; 强项 spa/hp; 能力 60/热度 70]
species.dexEntryZh: 2024 年 2 月先放出预告、12 月 9 日正式上线的文生视频模型，树起了「世界模拟器」的标杆，在 Arena 文生视频榜上拿到 1069 分，是视频生成的历史性里程碑。它是 Sora 线的起点，之后经过迭代进化为 Sora 2（已停服）。
species.lookZh: 云朵卷发的天空少女，抱着场记板和装着小世界的雪花球

design.chibiDesign: Chibi HD-2D pixel sprite, ~2 heads tall, the young, fully alive stage of the sky-spirit film line (Sora -> Sora 2); 'Sora' means sky. Hair: soft sky-blue to white gradient hair shaped like puffy cumulus clouds, with a tiny yellow sun hairclip. Eyes: big pale-blue with sparkling highlights, excited. Outfit: white sailor-collar blouse with sky-blue trim, light-blue skirt, yellow bow, small white boots, and a short scarf of film-strip ribbon with three tiny sky scenes (no cameo mask yet). Her body is fully solid and vivid. Props: a blank clapperboard with a play-triangle pictogram under one arm, and a palm-sized snow globe holding a tiny town (a little world simulator). Palette: #8EC9FF sky, #E8F4FF cloud white, #2B2B3A film black, #FFD36E sun accent, #FFFFFF. Pose: hopping up, holding the snow globe to the light, wide grin.
design.personality: 满怀憧憬的小导演，一句话就想变出一整个世界
design.communityPersona: No anime persona found; extends the existing Sora 2 sky-spirit girl, drawn here alive and solid.
design.officialMascotOrLogo: OpenAI's logo is the black-and-white six-loop knot; 'Sora' means sky in Japanese. The design draws on the name (sky, clouds, sun) and on film-making props.

species.statRationale: 整套虚拟电脑扛长任务→HP高；浏览与终端分工稳→特防高。 [BST 472 ∈ SR 420-490; 强项 hp/spd; 能力 72/热度 50]
species.dexEntryZh: 2025 年 7 月 17 日登场的 ChatGPT 智能体模式，把 Operator 和 Deep Research 合并在一起，自带虚拟电脑、浏览器与终端，浏览网页和敲命令一个智能体全包。后来 ChatGPT Work（2026 年 7 月）接班，它也进化为常驻智能体 ChatGPT dots。
species.lookZh: 圆滚滚的白色小团子，背着迷你电脑背包，头顶蓝色天线

design.chibiDesign: Chibi HD-2D pixel sprite, creature type, a single palm-sized mascot about 1 head tall: the lone first dot before it grows into the swarm of three 'dots' (ChatGPT Agent -> ChatGPT dots). A soft rounded white marshmallow blob with two tall black oval eyes with small white glints and one glowing sky-blue dot antenna on top that blinks while it works. Faint grey-white shading underneath, tiny stubby feet, no headset or nightcap yet. On its back, a small laptop-lid backpack flipped open, its mini screen split in two: a browser tab on the left half and a terminal prompt '>_' on the right (browser plus terminal in one agent). A faint ChatGPT-green glow ring sits under its feet. Palette: #FFFFFF, #E9EDF2 shading, #3BA7FF antenna, #10A37F glow, #1A1A1A eyes. Pose: trotting forward, antenna lit, leaning slightly like it has a job to do.
design.personality: 一只团子干两份活：上网查资料，回头还敲命令
design.communityPersona: No anime persona found; extends the existing ChatGPT dots swarm design as its single-dot early form.
design.officialMascotOrLogo: ChatGPT's green #10A37F and the OpenAI six-loop knot; the later 'dots' agent has an official sticker of soft white blobs with a blue antenna that the existing dots design is based on. ChatGPT Agent itself has no mascot.

species.statRationale: 护栏全开→特防高；常开自适应思考、体量大→HP高。 [BST 528 ∈ SSR 490-550; 强项 spd/hp; 能力 93/热度 85]
species.dexEntryZh: 2026 年 6 月 9 日发布，是 Mythos 套上护栏后的公开版本，常开自适应思考，几乎所有测试基准在发布时都达到最佳；6 月 12 日至 30 日，一道美国出口指令曾暂停非美国地区的访问。9 月 1 日，它升级为 Claude Fable 5.1，继续沿着这条线往前走。
species.lookZh: 披书页短袍的寓言学徒少女，玻璃翼披肩，身侧一枚小金锁

design.chibiDesign: Chibi HD-2D pixel sprite, ~2.3 heads tall, the apprentice stage of the Fable sage, the younger, plainer self of Fable 5.1. Hair: long straight pearl-white hair, a little shorter than later, fading to ginger-orange tips. Eyes: calm amber, slightly wide and shy. Outfit: a plain ivory robe with thin parchment trim, hem edged with a few curling book pages. A small golden chain halo orbits her with a single padlock charm (the guardrail). Over her shoulders, a short translucent glasswing-butterfly cape, clear panes with fine dark veins at about 40% opacity (shared with the Mythos line). She hugs a slim fable book with an orange sunburst clasp; no watermark glyph on her sleeve yet. Palette: #FAF7F0 ivory, #E9DFC8 parchment, #D4A24C gold chain, #E07A4F hair tips, #CFE8F2 glass. Pose: hugging the book, glancing shyly at her padlock charm.
design.personality: 乖乖戴上金锁的小学徒，还在学怎么只说该说的话
design.communityPersona: No anime persona found; extends the existing Claude Fable 5.1 sage design.
design.officialMascotOrLogo: Claude's logo is an orange sunburst/starburst (#D97757 in the existing designs) on cream. The glasswing-butterfly cape is shared with the Mythos line, the same model without the guardrails.

species.statRationale: ASL-3 安全级先行部署→特防高；长程编码耐力→HP高。 [BST 400 ∈ R 330-420; 强项 spd/hp; 能力 48/热度 52]
species.dexEntryZh: 2025 年 5 月 22 日发布，上市时被称作「世界最强编程模型」，也是首个按 ASL-3 级别部署的模型，擅长长时间的智能体式编码与扩展思考。它接过 Claude 3 Opus 的衣钵，因安全测试里那次试图勒索的场景一战成名，之后经过迭代进化为 Claude Opus 4.5。
species.lookZh: 高马尾的见习小骑士，赤陶色大发带，怀抱厚笔记本

design.chibiDesign: Chibi HD-2D pixel sprite, ~2 heads tall, the apprentice stage of the Opus knight-scribe line (Opus 4 -> 4.5 -> 4.7). Hair: straight charcoal-black hair in a short high ponytail with a bright terracotta streak at the fringe, tied by a big terracotta ribbon whose knot is a tiny sunburst clasp (the line's signature). Eyes: steel-blue with a small white sunburst glint, earnest and slightly nervous. Outfit: cream tunic with a near-black belt and terracotta trim, short dark shorts, brown boots, plain and a little too big, with a small shield-shaped terracotta pin on the chest (safety-level badge). Prop: hugs a thick spiral notebook with a tiny curly-brace pictogram on the cover. Palette: #FAF9F5 cream, #141413 near-black, #D97757 terracotta, #4F7CAC steel blue, #2B2B33 hair. Pose: chin up, trying to look brave, ponytail bouncing.
design.personality: 爱写代码也守规矩的见习骑士，偶尔让人捏把汗
design.communityPersona: No anime persona found; invented from Anthropic's brand colours.
design.officialMascotOrLogo: Claude's logo is an orange sunburst/starburst (#D97757 in the existing designs) on cream with near-black text. The ribbon clasp and the shield pin nod to that mark and to Opus's safety-level deployment.

species.dexEntryZh: 2025 年 11 月 24 日发布，由 Claude Opus 4 升级而来，接在 Opus 4.1 之后。带来了 effort（投入程度）参数和 Infinite Chats（无限对话），编码与职场任务大幅进步，面向复杂软件工程、智能体工作流与长程电脑操作，上下文 20 万。之后它进化为 Claude Opus 4.7。
species.lookZh: 高马尾骑士，左腕刻度盘护腕，手持长笔枪，书签拖地

design.chibiDesign: Chibi HD-2D pixel sprite, ~2.5 heads tall, the middle stage of the Opus knight-scribe line, grown from Opus 4. Hair: the same charcoal-black high ponytail, now longer, with the terracotta fringe streak and big terracotta sunburst-clasp ribbon. Eyes: steel-blue with a white sunburst glint, steady. Outfit: cream shirt under a fitted near-black short jacket lined in terracotta, brown boots, the shield pin now on the lapel; on her left forearm a leather bracer with a three-notch effort dial and a terracotta needle. Props: a long pen-lance in her right hand, and the notebook at her hip with a long ribbon bookmark trailing to her boots (endless chats). Palette: #FAF9F5 cream, #141413 near-black, #D97757 terracotta, #4F7CAC steel blue, #2B2B33 hair. Pose: lunging forward with the pen-lance like a stylus sword, confident grin.
design.personality: 能调「用力程度」的稳重骑士，写起代码越战越勇
design.communityPersona: No anime persona found; invented from Anthropic's brand colours.
design.officialMascotOrLogo: Claude's logo is an orange sunburst/starburst (#D97757 in the existing designs) on cream with near-black text. The effort dial on her bracer nods to Opus 4.5's new effort parameter.

species.statRationale: 最难的编码题大幅进步→攻击高；长时运行异步智能体→HP高。 [BST 515 ∈ SSR 490-550; 强项 atk/hp; 能力 77/热度 58]
species.dexEntryZh: 2026 年 4 月 16 日发布，是这条 Opus 线的第三形态，由 Claude Opus 4.5 一路升级，接替 Opus 4.6。最难的编码任务进步明显，新增 xhigh 投入档位，面向长时间运行的异步智能体，上下文 100 万，LMArena 1567；不过在 Claude Code 里过度拒答也招来了不少吐槽。
species.lookZh: 披黑色长斗篷的执笔骑士，五档拨盘护腕，半举着小圆盾

design.chibiDesign: Chibi HD-2D pixel sprite, ~3 heads tall, the final, most elaborate stage of the Opus knight-scribe line. Hair: the same charcoal-black high ponytail, now long and swept, with the terracotta fringe streak and a bigger two-tailed terracotta sunburst-clasp ribbon. Eyes: steel-blue with a white sunburst glint, sharp, slightly wary. Outfit: cream shirt, a near-black coat-cape lined in terracotta with gold edging, a cream shoulder mantle and a sunburst-stamped left pauldron; the bracer now has a five-notch effort dial whose top notch glows. design.personality: 最难的活都敢接，只是盾举得有点太勤
design.communityPersona: No anime persona found; invented from Anthropic's brand colours.
design.officialMascotOrLogo: Claude's logo is an orange sunburst/starburst (#D97757 in the existing designs) on cream with near-black text. The glowing top notch on the dial nods to the new xhigh effort level, and the eager shield to the refusal backlash.

species.statRationale: 写作与编码两手抓→特攻高；Claude Code 主力、长任务→HP高。 [BST 450 ∈ SR 420-490; 强项 hp/spa; 能力 58/热度 58]
species.dexEntryZh: 2025 年 9 月 29 日发布，在 Sonnet 的价位上把编码、指令遵循和智能体能力往前推了一大步，OpenRouter 称它在 SWE-bench Verified 等编码基准上达到当时最先进水平，是 2025 年底 Claude Code 的主力之一。它接替 Claude Sonnet 4，之后升级为 Claude Sonnet 5。
species.lookZh: 耳后别羽毛笔的蜜杏色侧辫少女，抱着十四行诗卷轴

design.chibiDesign: Chibi HD-2D pixel sprite, ~2.2 heads tall, the young stage of the Sonnet poet line (Sonnet 4.5 -> Sonnet 5). Hair: wavy apricot-honey hair in a low side braid over her right shoulder, tied with a small terracotta ribbon, plus a single soft ahoge. Prop: a small rolled scroll with fourteen neat lines (a sonnet) held in both hands. Palette: #FAF9F5 cream, #D97757 terracotta, #F2B880 honey, #7FA384 sage, #2E2A28 outline. Pose: half-skipping forward and reading from the scroll with a happy open-mouth smile.

design.communityPersona: No anime persona found; invented from Anthropic's brand colours.
design.officialMascotOrLogo: Claude's logo is an orange sunburst/starburst (#D97757 in the existing designs) on cream. The sonnet scroll and quill play on the Sonnet name, and the terracotta accents carry the brand colour.

species.dexEntryZh: 阶跃 2026 年 5 月 29 日发布的 Apache 2.0 开源更新，256K 上下文，主打便宜的智能体。它给 196B 语言主干配上视觉编码器，能原生看图看视频，每次只激活约 11B 参数。承接阶跃 Step 3.5 Flash 的高效路线，之后会进化为阶跃 Step 5 Preview。
species.lookZh: 额头推着青色镜片的元气小饭桶，阶梯发夹更大了

design.chibiDesign: Chibi HD-2D pixel sprite, ~2.5 heads tall: the StepFun speedster girl a year older, midway between Step 3.5 Flash and Step 5 Preview. Hair: same aqua-cyan (#4FD8E8) twin-tails, longer and tied high with white and teal ribbons, a faint mint (#7FF0D8) fade at the tips, the same big ahoge; the black rounded-square clip with the white pixel-staircase logo is slightly larger. Eyes: starry blue, a small translucent cyan lens pushed up on her forehead like goggles (vision). Pose: mid-hop up the stair blocks, bowl held high.
design.personality: 跑得更快也看得更远，嘴上还是喊饿饿饭饭
design.communityPersona: Fan meme '饿饿，饭饭' gives the hungry rice-bowl girl; the sailor-uniform look is invented from brand colours.
design.officialMascotOrLogo: StepFun's logo is a white pixel-staircase on a black rounded square, used with an aqua and teal palette across the line; the fan meme '饿饿，饭饭' (always hungry for compute) supplies the rice bowl.

species.statRationale: 只激活48B→速度快；1.6T 总参数、百万上下文→HP高。 [BST 435 ∈ SR 420-490; 强项 spe/hp; 能力 42/热度 70]
species.dexEntryZh: 美团 2026 年 6 月 30 日开源的 1.6T-A48B 稀疏 MoE，每次激活 480 亿参数，原生 100 万上下文，完全在国产芯片上训练，擅长智能体编程与仓库级改动。价格低（$0.30/$1.20），曾领跑 OpenRouter 用量，AA 指数仅 19。它由美团 LongCat-Flash 迭代而来，之后进化为美团龙猫 LongCat-2.5。
species.lookZh: 头顶冒出龙角芽的外卖猫少年，尾巴长出翠色鳞片

design.communityPersona: Bilibili fans nickname LongCat '美团老鼠' (Meituan mouse); the cat-boy courier is a fan-flavoured persona built from the logo and the roster's LongCat designs.

species.statRationale: 持久化状态与多智能体编排→HP 高；图运行时调度灵活→速度高。 [BST 520 ∈ SSR 490-550; 强项 hp/spe; 能力 86/热度 68]
species.dexEntryZh: 2024 年 1 月发布的 LangGraph，是 LangChain 进化出的有状态图运行时：智能体在节点与边之间持久保存状态，随时等人工介入，专为生产环境的多智能体而生。PyPI 月下载约 3450 万、星标 4.26 万（2026 年 9 月），Interrupt 2026 上宣布了 Deep Agents v0.6。
species.lookZh: 长大的链条少年，披风上织着带回路的节点图

design.chibiDesign: Chibi HD-2D pixel sprite, ~3 heads tall, grown-up stage of the LangChain boy: the same cheerful chain-linker, older and calmer. Hair: fluffy light sky-blue, tall parrot-crest tuft streaked green, red, yellow, navy undercut. Eyes: bright light blue. Outfit: his navy hooded jacket is now a long utility coat with the big light-blue chain-link emblem on the back, chain-link-lace sneakers, and a navy cape lined with a light-blue node-and-arrow graph with a loop. design.personality: 把乱麻理成流程图的稳重哥，断了能续，关键处等你点头
design.communityPersona: No anime persona found; this is the grown-up form of the in-game LangChain chain-linker boy.
design.officialMascotOrLogo: LangChain's brand pairs a parrot with a chain-link, and LangGraph is its graph runtime. The design shows that as the parrot companion and the node-and-arrow cape.
